name: create_event
description: Schedule a new study session, class, sleep block, or free block on the StudyFlow calendar.

title.description: Title of the calendar event or study block.

date.description: Local start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

startHour.description: Start time as 24-hour decimal (e.g., 9.5 for 09:30, 14 for 14:00, 19.25 for 19:15).

startTime.description: Optional alternative start time in HH:MM 24-hour format (e.g., '14:30').

durationHours.description: Duration in hours (e.g., 1, 1.5, 2). Defaults to 1 if omitted.

subjectId.description: Optional matching subject ID or subject code from workspace context.

notes.description: Optional session agenda or study notes.

weekdays.description: Optional repeating weekdays using Monday=0 through Sunday=6. Include all 7 for daily recurrence.

name: update_event
description: Update an existing calendar session or recurring series.

id.description: Existing session ID from workspace context.

scope.description: Required when editing a recurring event.

name: delete_event
description: Delete an existing calendar event (StudyFlow will ask the student to confirm first).

name: create_task
description: Create a new study task or assignment in StudyFlow.

date.description: Optional due date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

subjectId.description: Optional subject ID or subject code.

name: update_task
description: Update an existing task's title, due date, priority, or status.

name: complete_tasks
description: Mark one or more existing tasks complete (StudyFlow will ask for confirmation when bulk-completing).

name: delete_tasks
description: Delete one or more existing tasks (StudyFlow will ask the student to confirm first).

name: create_exam
description: Add a new exam or assessment to StudyFlow Exams.

time.description: Optional exam time in HH:MM 24-hour format.

subjectId.description: Optional subject ID or subject code.

name: update_exam
description: Update an existing exam's details or prep progress.

name: delete_exam
description: Delete an existing exam (StudyFlow will ask the student to confirm first).

name: create_goal
description: Create a new study goal or milestone target in StudyFlow Goals.

deadline.description: Optional deadline in YYYY-MM-DD or short label.

milestones.description: Optional milestone step titles for this goal.

name: add_goal_milestone
description: Add a milestone step to an existing goal.

goalId.description: Existing goal ID or goal title.

name: create_note
description: Create a new Markdown study note in StudyFlow Notes.

subjectId.description: Optional subject ID or subject code.

name: update_note
description: Update an existing Markdown note's content or title.

name: delete_note
description: Delete an existing note (StudyFlow will ask the student to confirm first).

name: create_deck
description: Create a new flashcard deck in StudyFlow Flashcards.

subjectId.description: Optional subject ID or subject code.

name: create_flashcards
description: Create flashcards from a student's note or study topic and save them to an existing deck (deckId) or a new deck (deckTitle).

noteId.description: Optional source note ID or note title from workspace context.

deckId.description: Existing deck ID to add cards to.

deckTitle.description: If creating a new deck or matching by name, provide the deck title.

subjectId.description: Optional subject ID or code if creating a new deck.

cards.description: Array of flashcards with front (question/prompt) and back (concise answer).

name: create_practice_test
description: Create an interactive timed practice test (MCQ, multi-select, and/or short answer) grounded in the student's notes or topic.

noteId.description: Optional source note ID or title from workspace context.

subjectId.description: Optional subject ID or subject code.

answer.description: Exact option text for mcq, newline-separated exact options for multi, or expected concise answer for short.

name: start_focus_session
description: Configure and start a StudyFlow Focus Timer session and optionally switch to the Focus view.

taskTitle.description: What the student will focus on.

subjectId.description: Optional subject ID or subject code.

minutes.description: Optional duration in minutes (used when mode is Custom).

name: navigate_to_view
description: Open a specific page inside StudyFlow when the user asks to go there.

noteId.description: Optional note ID to select when opening notes.
